query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> AND script_hash IN ('148c5cbcebfcf7f62d4555171b0e354273eb759929c8f410d6a1fe03', '1e0c1a445e185485277c044d77d2b1aaf80aa489a28a4c1e11ec8df0', '37ec634d8f988ba9157f31bc7f024a6a2d8b8d483fa082de62d43bd1', '497a8b0085517f1c9065cf3006af4c266454b39c6fa32a9d116c75ee')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
